description: Mobile surface: Fix VidAPI embed URL compliance, add netflix skin parameter, add ds_lang parameter support, add language selection capability, and implement invalid movie filtering
steps: 1. Fix apps/mobile/src/utils/player.js - Change `?t=` to `?resumeAt=` in both getMovieEmbedUrl and getTVEmbedUrl to match VidAPI documentation.

2. Add skin and dsLang parameters to apps/mobile/src/utils/player.js - Modify getMovieEmbedUrl and getTVEmbedUrl to accept an options object { skin, dsLang } and append these as query params. Default skin to 'netflix'. Example output: https://vaplayer.ru/embed/movie/12345?resumeAt=300&skin=netflix&ds_lang=id

3. Create apps/mobile/src/utils/language.js - A simple async module using AsyncStorage to store the selected language ('en' or 'id'). Export async getCurrentLanguage() and async setLanguage(lang). Default is 'en'.
4. Update apps/mobile/src/app/player.jsx - Import getCurrentLanguage and pass the dsLang and skin options to getMovieEmbedUrl/getTVEmbedUrl when building the embed URL.
5. Update apps/mobile/src/app/movie/[id].jsx - When navigating to player, include the current language preference (or let the player screen handle it).

6. Add a language selector to the mobile app - Add a simple language toggle in apps/mobile/src/app/(tabs)/_layout.jsx or in the header of the tab navigator. Show EN/ID buttons. On press, update AsyncStorage via setLanguage(). The player screen should read this when building URLs.

7. Add invalid item filtering to apps/mobile/src/utils/api.js - After fetching list data, filter items to ensure they have valid id and title fields. Export a helper filterValidItems that removes entries with falsy id or empty/missing title.
8. Update apps/mobile/src/components/ContentGrid.jsx - As a safety net, skip rendering items that lack an id or title in the FlatList keyExtractor/renderItem logic.
acceptance_criteria: getMovieEmbedUrl(id, 300, { skin: 'netflix', dsLang: 'id' }) returns URL with ?resumeAt=300&skin=netflix&ds_lang=id
Language selector is accessible in the mobile app (in tab layout header or settings)
Selecting ID stores preference and subsequent player URLs include ds_lang=id
ContentGrid and api.js filter out items without valid id/title
TypeScript/ESLint check passes for mobile: cd apps/mobile && npx tsc --noEmit
verification: cd apps/mobile && bun install && npx tsc --noEmit
